subject: Audit rights: proposed sampling schedule + technical evidence request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@mediconnect.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: privacy_ops@mediconnect.com
Date: Sun, 11 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial evidence & sampling ask for onboarding audit

Hi Rohan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our privacy team is starting the onboarding checklist and has a few concrete asks so we can close the DPA and schedule a short DPIA review. We'd like to consolidate evidence into a single package. Can you confirm you can provide the following by May 18?

Required items:
- Article 28 / Article 30 processing ledger extract for the Mediconnect tenant (csv)
- Subprocessor roster with contract dates and transfer safeguards
- A sampling plan for access logs (we'll need 3 sample days across March–April 2025)
- DPIA summary and pointer to relevant ops runbooks
- Proof of KMS wrap/CMK usage for exported logs (high level)

I've attached a short evidence request (mediconnect_evidence_request_05112025.pdf) that our auditors will use. We're happy to accept staged delivery — sampling first, then ledger and runbooks.

Can you loop in the folks who will own the technical extracts? Also flag any items that need an SLA exception (e.g., live access to production logs) and we can route to legal.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Privacy, Mediconnect

(attachment: mediconnect_evidence_request_05112025.pdf)

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@mediconnect.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial evidence & sampling ask for onboarding audit

Samir —

Thanks for the clear list and the PDF — we can absolutely support this. Quick plan and ask from our side:

1) Sampling schedule
   - We'll provide 3 sample days as requested. Proposed sample days: 2025-03-05, 2025-03-18, 2025-04-08. If those work for your auditors, we'll extract TTL-limited copies and redact PII fields per your spec.

2) Art.28/30 ledger + subprocessor roster
   - We'll deliver an art30_extract.csv and a subprocessor_roster.csv. Roster will include contract dates and the transfer mechanism (SCCs / adequacy) where applicable.

3) KMS proof + DPIA summary
   - We can provide a high-level KMS wrap statement and our DPIA summary (ops-runbook links). We won't share HSM credentials; we'll provide attestations and key usage logs.

4) SLAs & access
   - If your auditors require on-demand access to production logs or live queries, we'll need a short SLA exception (security review). Ben — can you flag contract language and the quickest path to a limited addendum / DocuSign?

I'm attaching a draft sampling plan (sampling_plan_v1.xlsx) that Neha will use to coordinate extracts. Neha — can you confirm retention windows and the redaction fields we should apply? Ideally we hand off CSV extracts by EOD Tue 5/20, with a final package the week after.

Rohan Mehta
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

(attachment: sampling_plan_v1.xlsx)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com, Samir Patel <samir.patel@mediconnect.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial evidence & sampling ask for onboarding audit

Samir / Rohan —

Thanks — quick clarifying questions so we scope the extracts correctly:

- Retention window: do you want events for full request lifecycle (tokenization + inference events), or only inference request metadata? If both, list which fields must be redacted (we suggest hashing user identifiers and redacting raw prompt text unless you request full prompt access).
- Audit sampling: do you want contiguous days or non-contiguous? The sampling_plan_v1 suggests non-contiguous to capture workload variance.
- KMS evidence: we can provide a key-usage CSV showing wrap/unwrap events and the envelope key IDs; would that satisfy your auditors? We cannot share private KMS material, only usage logs and key metadata.

Attached is our retention_matrix.pdf which maps default retention by data class. We'll use the matrix to filter extracts. If you confirm:

Deliverables and rough timeline:
- 5/20: three sampled CSV extracts (redacted as agreed)
- 5/22: art30_extract.csv + subprocessor_roster.csv (with transfer mechanism column)
- 5/26: DPIA summary + KMS usage logs (CSV)

If Mediconnect needs an SLA exception for live log access or a supervised audit session, Ben mentioned starting a DPA addendum. Otherwise the staged artifacts above should satisfy standard onboarding audits.

Neha Kapoor
Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference

(attachment: retention_matrix.pdf)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com, Samir Patel <samir.patel@mediconnect.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Mediconnect Legal <legal@mediconnect.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial evidence & sampling ask for onboarding audit

Quick commercial note — copying Legal to kick off the MD-2025-1182 DPA addendum for the limited audit access window. Samir, if you confirm supervised access is required, we'll propose language for a 7-day supervised session (non-production snapshot) and a nominal fee for on-site/remote support.

Otherwise we'll proceed with the staged artifact delivery Neha outlined. Rohan — please track the artifacts to the drive link and I will route the DocuSign when Legal drafts the addendum.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
